description: A one-bedroom sky residence: engineered oak underfoot, a wall of glass framing the bay, and a low platform bed dressed in cloud-grey linen. The kitchen is a single seam of stone with no visible handles. Everything is quiet, warm, and exactly where it should be — the ambient hum of a life without friction. The door locks with a whisper. Leave south to the landing.
name: Solenne Residence 30-A
